data.text:
Abdul Gaffar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food ... on 28 
August, 2024 
Author: Sangeeta Chandra
Bench: Sangeeta Chandra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:58378-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 7304 of 2024
Petitioner :- Abdul Gaffar 
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food Safety And Drug Administration Lk Counsel for Petitioner :- Shikhar Chaube,Nitesh Kumar Mishra Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Anil Kumar Tripathi Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record. 
This petition has been filed with the following main prayer :-
"(i) to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding &
directing the opposite party no.5 to consider and decide the representation dated 04.04.2024, as contained in Annexure No.1 to this writ petition, within a short and reasonable time as prescribed by this Hon'ble Court, in the interest of justice. 
(ii) issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding &
Abdul Gaffar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food ... on 28 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36967660/
1 directing the opposite parties/ authorities concerned to grant, the petitioner, a licence as a Food business Operator as provided under Regulation 2.1 (Chapter II) of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses)
Regulations, 2011 and allow the petitioner to operate his meat shop further commanding the opposite parties not to interfere/ disturb in peaceful operation of the meat shop of the petitioner without following due procedure of law." 
It is the case of the petitioner that the petitioner intends to set up business of running a meat shop and has applied for licence as a food business operator under the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulation, 2011. Nagar Palika Parishad has issued NOC but the police authorities have not yet issued NOC and the application has been made which is pending before them since then. 
This petition is disposed of with the direction to the opposite party no.5 to look into the application made by the petitioner and pass appropriate order strictly in accordance with law within two months from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before him. 
Order Date :- 28.8.2024 mks  Abdul Gaffar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food ... on 28 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36967660/
